# Test fixtures

**Synthetic only.** Never add a real student's work, a real detector report, or any
personal data here — not even anonymised. Every fixture must be generated or written by
hand for testing, and generators live next to the fixtures they produce.

| Folder | What it holds |
|---|---|
| `reports/` | report-schema examples |
| `profiles/`, `profiles_invalid/` | a synthetic institution profile, and broken ones |
| `audit/` | a synthetic essay, a report consistent with it (206 words, 47%), a declarations file and an assignment brief, for the similarity auditor |
